context.transcript:
Hi Ayumi.
Have you thought of any ways we can make our website more appealing?
It seems like other home renovation contractors get more new clients from online searches than we do.
Well, I know many of our prospective clients ask to see examples of our work.
We should take before and after photos of our home renovations for an online portfolio.
An online portfolio is a great idea.
I'll look at our spending budget and see if we can hire a professional photographer to help us photograph some of the homes we're working on.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨 Ayumi。
你有没有想过一些让我们的网站更吸引人的方法？
看起来其他家居装修承包商从在线搜索获取的新客户比我们多。
嗯，我知道许多潜在客户要求看我们工作的例子。
我们应该拍摄我们家居翻修的“之前和之后”照片，制作一个在线作品集。
在线作品集是个好主意。
我会查看我们的支出预算，看看我们是否能聘请一位专业摄影师来帮助我们拍摄一些正在进行中的房屋。
